narr: The trailing end of a 500 mb shortwave trough over the Great Lakes region extended down into the lower Ohio Valley. Scattered slow-moving thunderstorms near the trough axis produced isolated flash flooding.
ev: Numerous roads were underwater in the southern part of the county, including State Route 545 near New Boston, County Road 200 West near Rockport, State Route 161 near Richland City, and County Road 200 North near Reo. An observer in Grandview measured 2.54 inches between midnight and sunrise.
